name: torrent-file-editor
description: Commits its PRIVATE Sparkle DSA signing key (cmake/dsa_priv.pem, since ~2019) to the public repo — anyone can forge a sparkle:dsaSignature that validates against the pinned dsa_pub.pem. A DEFEATED Tier A: transport is sound (HTTPS off github.io), so it lands at C, not D. Needs a delivery position (github.io/appcast compromise or TLS MitM) — not a turnkey takeover. macOS-only Sparkle (bg check, user-prompted install, gatekeeper-signed); Windows path is notify-only.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: torrent-file-editor integrates Sparkle on macOS. The original claim about release-signing key exposure requires release-specific key provenance and remediation review before publication; this review does not certify forgery or takeover claims.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; key use in historical artifacts, pinned-key configuration, installer prompting, and Windows notify-only behavior were not established.

trust_root: pinned pubkey — but private key committed, so forgeable

original_evidence.text: | torrent-file-editor | https://github.com/torrent-file-editor/torrent-file-editor | C++/Qt | Y | Y on macOS (Sparkle `checkForUpdatesInBackground` called unconditionally at every launch, `SUEnableAutomaticChecks=true`, `SUScheduledCheckInterval=86400`); N on Windows (manual "Check for update" button in About dialog, `Q_OS_WIN`-only, no periodic timer found); N/A on Linux (`checkupdate.cpp` is compiled only under `Q_OS_WIN`, no updater path exists for Linux at all) | Y — macOS path uses the Sparkle framework, whose default legacy (`SUUpdater`) behavior is to download and install the update package automatically (outside this repo, inside the external Sparkle framework); Windows path is display-only (N: shows a clickable version/link, `Q_UNUSED(url)`/no download call in `aboutdlg.cpp`) | macOS: https appcast at `SUFeedURL = https://torrent-file-editor.github.io/appcast/appcast.xml`, delivered/verified by the external Sparkle framework (verification logic itself not in this repo); Windows: https `appcast.json` at `https://torrent-file-editor.github.io/appcast/appcast.json`, fetched via raw WinINet (`InternetOpenUrl`), no TLS-pinning/cert-checks beyond OS defaults visible in code | macOS: Sparkle appcast items are typically per-item DSA/EdDSA-signed (standard Sparkle behavior; this repo configures `SUPublicDSAKeyFile`, implying legacy DSA-signed enclosures); Windows: N (plain JSON `appcast.json`, no signature field parsed at all) | macOS: signature (DSA via Sparkle, `SUPublicDSAKeyFile = dsa_pub.pem`) — **but the matching DSA PRIVATE key is committed in this same repository** at `cmake/dsa_priv.pem` and is actively used by the release build (`cmake/Dmg.cmake:11`, `openssl dgst -dss1 -sign cmake/dsa_priv.pem`) to sign the DMG, meaning anyone who clones this public repo can forge a validly-signed malicious update; Windows: none | `dsa_pub.pem` (repo root, public key) paired with `cmake/dsa_priv.pem` (repo, **private** key — critical exposure); the public key is also installed into the app bundle at `CMakeLists.txt:511` | `main.cpp:258-262` (`#ifdef Q_OS_MAC` block: `SparkleAutoUpdater *updater = new SparkleAutoUpdater; updater->checkForUpdates();` runs on every launch); `sparkleautoupdater.mm:32-49` (wraps `[SUUpdater sharedUpdater] checkForUpdatesInBackground]`, legacy Sparkle 1.x API); `MacOSXBundleInfo.plist.in:61-68` (`SUFeedURL=https://torrent-file-editor.github.io/appcast/appcast.xml`, `SUPublicDSAKeyFile=dsa_pub.pem`, `SUScheduledCheckInterval=86400`, `SUEnableAutomaticChecks=true`); **`cmake/dsa_priv.pem:1-39` — full PEM-encoded DSA private signing key checked into the public repository**; `cmake/Dmg.cmake:11` (`openssl dgst -dss1 -sign "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/dsa_priv.pem"` — build script actively signs release DMGs with this committed private key); `dsa_pub.pem` (repo root, matching public key) and `CMakeLists.txt:511` (`install(FILES "dsa_pub.pem" DESTINATION "${PROJECT_NAME}.app/Contents/Resources" ...)`); `checkupdate.cpp:14-81` (Windows path: `CAST_URL = "https://torrent-file-editor.github.io/appcast/appcast.json"`, raw `wininet.h` `InternetOpen`/`InternetOpenUrl`/`InternetReadFile`, parses `version`/`url-win-x64` fields, emits `finished(version, url)` — no signature/hash field is read or checked); `aboutdlg.cpp:174-220` (`checkUpdate()` is `#ifdef Q_OS_WIN`-only and fires solely from the About dialog's button click, `ui->btCheckUpdate`; `showUpdate()` only sets label text with an `<a href>` link — no download/execution of the update). |
